decisions.reason: The air quality sensor has its own page, fits the growing demand for environmental sensing, and costs little to carry in a modular catalogue, so there is no shortfall that would trigger search.
The 3.0 version is the current generation that replaced version 2.0, so it is the product the firm retains rather than drops.
The MQTT proxy is a software extension of the platform that raises the value of all modules for IoT users at low maintenance cost, so it is kept.
The CAN bus module is only mentioned so far, but it serves industrial and automotive customers and there is no evidence of underperformance.
The CO2 sensor has its own page and meets clear demand from schools and building automation, fitting the firm's sensing strategy.
The touch panel accessory has its own page and is cheap to keep in stock, and with only a year on the market its uncertain results do not yet call for dropping it.
